hero.title: Recognition pattern

standard.title: Usage rules
items: A flat, unranked thank-you list — supporters are always sorted alphabetically by name within a category, never by gift size or date. There is no tier/rank field; a giving-tier donor wall is a deliberately different, out-of-scope design.

Optional `omissionNoteText`/`omissionNoteLinkLabel`/`omissionNoteHref` render a quiet fine-print line beneath the list acknowledging a name may have been missed, linking to the site's `/contact` page. All three must be set for it to render; omit all three to leave it off entirely.
No logo, no `url`, no dollar amount. Unlike `PartnersSection`'s organizations (which self-publish their own brand), every entry here names a real private individual.
`note` is optional — a short line under the name (e.g. "Monthly supporter," "In memory of Bella"). Keep it brief and factual; this is not a place for a giving-tier label.
A category with zero matching supporters renders nothing — no heading, no placeholder — same rule as `PartnersSection`.

This is a companion pattern to `PartnersSection`, not a merge — compose the two on the same page (e.g. a site's `/partners` page) when a site has both organizational partners and individual supporters to thank.
